column1: # Let's begin. This file specifies the different parameters that can be changed by the user and are read by the datalogger Arduinos. It can be generated by a Windows application that can be found here: https://github.com/flipoyo/MOLO-firmware-config or you can change the parameters using Notepad :)
# I won't repeat the explanations for the parameters that are already in the relay's config file (mains_ino/relay/conf.csv) :) so go check that file first if you want a detailed description of appEui

column4: totalNbOfDataloggers - 1) assigned to this specific datalogger so that multiple dataloggers don't talk to the relay at the exact same time. A datalogger with slot 0 will communicate first (from 0s to time_window)
column5: slot 1 will go second (from time_window to 2*time_window)
column6: and so on. Just make sure this index matches the order in which you listed this datalogger's devEui in the relay's conf.csv.

column2: it simply sets how often (in seconds) the datalogger wakes up to take a measurement from its sensors. For example
column3: in this case the datalogger takes measurements once every 80 seconds.

column1: # These lines list the physical sensors plugged into the Arduino using the format: ID
column3: pin. Here we have 1 pressure sensor (P1 on pin A0) and 5 temperature sensors (T1 to T5 on their respective analog pins).
